(TECHNICAL STANDARD ORDER) CERTIFIED EQPT HOWEVER ANY SUSPECTED 

INTERFERENCE SHOULD BE REPORTED IN ACCORDANCE WITH NEW ZEALAND CIVIL 

AVIATION AUTHORITY (CAA) RULE PART 12.



FURTHER INFORMATION IS AVBL FROM THE CAA WEBSITE: 

HTTPS://WWW.CAA.GOVT.NZ/NSS/SATELLITE-BASED-AUGMENTATION-SYSTEM-SBAS-
